description: With Lex Luthor apparently gone, Lois and Clark's partnership grows more intimate while new enemies learn how vulnerable Superman can be to kryptonite, technology and public opinion. Metallo, the Prankster, Intergang and a resurrected Luthor repeatedly threaten them, while Mayson Drake and Dan Scardino complicate the Lois-Clark-Superman triangle. By the finale, Clark's secret is used against his parents and Lois, pushing him to stop circling the relationship and ask Lois to marry him.

s02e01.description: Lex Luthor's ex-wife Arianna Carlin sets out to destroy the people she blames for his death, using a Lois look-alike to discredit Lois and turn Superman against her. Clark and Lois have to unravel the impersonation before Arianna's revenge becomes fatal.

s02e02.description: An award nomination creates a rift between Clark and Lois; strange sounds cripple the city and Superman.

s02e03.description: While trying to get Lois reinstated in her job, Lois and Clark uncover political and corporate corruption.

s02e04.description: Kyle Griffin, a criminal Lois once helped send to prison, returns as the Prankster and bombards her with elaborate threats and booby-trapped gifts. His harassment is cover for a larger scheme involving stolen components for a nuclear weapon.

s02e05.description: An international crime group targets Lois and her uncle; a prosecutor lusts for Clark but despises Superman.

s02e06.description: A blackout is linked to a computer genius and a colonel set to hijack a satellite that can destroy the world.

s02e07.description: Clark is mortally injured when a genetic experiment regenerates three infamous mobsters and a lethal gun moll.

s02e08.description: A misfit gains powers equal to Superman's; a deranged scientist wants to transform them to a Superman foe.

s02e09.description: A bitter inventor's new toy brings out the worst in the shoppers of Metropolis during the holiday season.

s02e10.description: Lucy Lane's boyfriend Johnny Corben is transformed into Metallo, a cybernetic weapon powered by kryptonite. With Superman physically overmatched by the machine's radioactive heart, Lois and Clark try to stop the men who rebuilt Johnny before they turn him fully against them.

s02e11.description: A series of Chinatown robberies leads Lois and Clark into a martial-arts conflict built around stolen mystical power. Superman's raw strength is little help against an enemy who can redirect energy through chi, forcing the investigation to matter as much as the fight.

s02e12.description: After acquiring a device that carries information on a beam of light, Lois is kidnapped by an evil ophthalmologist.

s02e13.description: Lex Luthor is secretly restored to life and returns to Metropolis determined to reclaim Lois and punish Superman. Working through the people who resurrected him, Luthor tries to separate Lois from Clark before revealing that his old obsession has survived with him.

s02e14.description: Television reporter Diana Stride pursues Superman's secret identity with the instincts of a rival journalist and the methods of an assassin. Her investigation closes in on Clark while she prepares a kryptonite-based attack designed to kill Superman once she has the evidence she wants.

s02e15.description: The Prankster escapes with a device that can freeze people in place, giving him a new way to terrorize Lois. His revenge campaign collides with her planned interview with the President, turning a personal vendetta into a threat to everyone at the event.

s02e16.description: Superman unwittingly aids the hijacking of a shipment of nuclear warheads; Clark and Lois ready for their first date.

s02e17.description: A deranged scientist plots to release a deadly virus in Metropolis; Lois' attraction to a government agent irks Clark.

s02e18.description: H.G. Wells' time machine carries Lois and Clark to 1966 Smallville to prevent a futuristic villain from killing the infant Superman.

s02e19.description: Jimmy falls under the influence of a mind-controlling serum that turns its victims into assassins who kill on command.

s02e20.description: After exposure to red kryptonite, a depressed Superman doesn't respond when Intergang kidnaps Perry.

s02e21.description: A man sues Superman for injuries he claims were caused during a rescue, forcing Clark to defend the very idea of intervening when people are in danger. At the same time, Lois must sort out her feelings for Clark, Superman and Dan Scardino as the romantic triangle finally becomes impossible to ignore.

s02e22.description: A blackmailer who has discovered Clark's identity threatens Jonathan and Martha and forces Superman to commit crimes while keeping Lois under close watch. Surviving the scheme convinces Clark that secrecy cannot keep defining his life with Lois, and he finally proposes to her.
